title: Phase One tariff announcements and implementing notices: supplementary register
scope: Two US notices published by January 2020; the January notice prescribes a February effective date. No entry-level collection or later compliance review.

sources.title: Notice of Modification of Section 301 Action: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation, FR Doc. 2019-27306
sources.author_or_institution: Office of the United States Trade Representative

event_dates.event: Phase One agreement announced; notice characterizes progress as the reason for modification.
Previously scheduled commencement of additional duties on Annex C products; suspended from that planned start.

sources.reading_status: Entire target notice read and visually checked
sources.read_scope: All target-notice text on the one-page PDF, printed 84 FR 69447: title through filing line, including dates, background, determination and operative HTSUS suspension. Preceding State Department notice excluded. Earlier tariff notices cited here not thereby counted as read.

locators.tariff_scope_and_reason: Section B, middle and right columns
locators.operative_suspension: Right column, paragraph beginning To give effect; HTSUS 9903.88.16 and notes 20(t), 20(u)

sources.evidentiary_use: Distinguishes indefinite suspension of planned December 15 duties from a separately forthcoming reduction of existing Annex A duties.
sources.limits: US administrative act and official account of negotiating progress. Does not disclose a bilateral tariff annex or private bargain, prove actual customs treatment of any entry, or put a 7.5 percent rate into effect in December.
sources.source_dependence: Primary implementing act; its negotiation account depends on US official reporting, rather than independently establishing Chinese assent to every described term.
sources.visual_verification: Full PDF p. 1 rendered as 2019-27306.png and read; text extraction preserved alongside. PDF metadata reflects later government file generation, not a change to the printed 2019 publication date.

sources.title: Notice of Modification of Section 301 Action: China's Acts, Policies, and Practices Related to Technology Transfer, Intellectual Property, and Innovation, FR Doc. 2020-00904
sources.author_or_institution: Office of the United States Trade Representative

event_dates.event: Agreement on a Phase One deal, as recounted in Section B.
Signature of Phase One, as recounted in Section B.
Scheduled agreement entry into force and prescribed effective date of the tariff reduction.

sources.reading_status: Entire target notice read and visually checked
sources.read_scope: All target-notice text on the one-page PDF, printed 85 FR 3741: title through filing line, including dates, background, determination and the full two-part Annex. Following FAA notice excluded. Earlier notices cited here not thereby counted as read.

locators.operative_reduction: Annex, right column; HTSUS note 20(r) and heading 9903.88.15

sources.evidentiary_use: Prescribes reduction from 15 percent to 7.5 percent for covered Annex A goods entered or withdrawn for consumption on or after February 14; links this prospective act to scheduled Phase One entry into force.
sources.limits: A January instrument scheduling later effect, not evidence that the lower rate already applied in December or at signature. No general elimination of existing tariffs, entry-level performance finding, or automatic future-remedy formula follows.
sources.source_dependence: Primary modification of US tariff rules; incorporates earlier US acts and official chronology. Distinct from the bilateral agreement's dispute provisions.
sources.visual_verification: Full PDF p. 1 rendered as 2020-00904.png and read; text extraction preserved alongside.

storage: Original PDFs, text extractions, rendered pages and retrieval manifest are preserved outside Git. No shared source ledger was edited.
